text: dsh.plus 是面向 DSH 网页端的插件目录浏览面板。它在设置页注册目录页面，由 DSH 主机提供只读目录接口，并从 dsh.plus 获取实时目录与 Star 数据。用户可以搜索名称和简介、按类别筛选、按热度或更新时间排序，查看插件仓库信息，并复制对应的 DSH CLI 安装命令。适合想在 DSH 内发现和比较社区插件的用户；使用时需要连接 dsh.plus。

dsh.plus adds a plugin catalog to DSH web settings. It loads live entries and star counts from dsh.plus, then lets users search, filter by category, sort, inspect repository details, and copy a DSH CLI install command. Useful for discovering community plugins in DSH; it requires access to dsh.plus.

有没有能搜索插件名称并按 Star 排序的目录页

在 DSH 里查看插件仓库、许可证和更新时间
DSH 插件目录加载失败时，怎样手动重试
I want to browse community plugins from DSH settings
Find a DSH plugin catalog with category filters and sorting
在设置页打开双语插件目录：客户端注册 settings.section 页面，并按 DSH 当前语言加载中文或英文目录。
搜索、筛选和排序目录：输入名称或简介关键词，按类别过滤，再按 Star、更新时间或名称排序。
查看插件信息并打开仓库：目录卡片展示简介、分类、Star、许可证、发布者和更新时间，并提供仓库链接。
复制插件安装命令：目录条目的仓库地址被转换为 DSH CLI 命令，用户点击复制后可粘贴到终端。
目录页面会请求 dsh.plus 获取插件条目和 Star 统计；无法连接时页面提供重试。
插件目录只展示可复制的安装命令；目录数据请求由 DSH 主机转发到 dsh.plus，每次读取不缓存。

dsh.plus README · dsh.plus：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin that shows the [dsh.plus](https://dsh.plus) curated plugin catalog inside DSH. Once installed, a **Plugin Catalog** page appears under DSH Settings, listing the human-curated DSH plugins from dsh.plus live: browse, search, filter by category, copy the install command, or open each plugin’s GitHub repository.

dsh.plus README · dsh.plus：> This plugin is a **read-only gallery**: it surfaces entries to other plugins. It installs nothing, executes no plugin code, and never mutates the profile. The install command is derived by the host from the GitHub repository URL and is shown for copying only.

dsh.plus README · Features：- **Live data**: the host fetches dsh.plus’s public catalog contract (`/v1/plugins` + `/plugin-index.json`) at runtime — the site updates and the gallery follows, with no extra deployment.
- **Bilingual**: plugin summaries load in zh or en to match the DSH UI language.
- **Search / category filter / sort**: name-and-summary search, six-category filter, and sorting by stars / updated time / name.
- **Copy the install command**: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:<owner>/<repo>`.
- **GitHub links**: every card opens the plugin repo and shows stars, license, publisher, last-updated time, and cover.
- **Safety boundary**: all remote fields are sanitized and URLs re-validated against the DSH Community Market contract; no install scripts or credentials ever pass through.
dsh.plus README · Install：```sh
dsh.plus README · from GitHub (dev / preview)：dsh plugin --profile web add github:zhaimingyou/dsh.plus

dsh.plus README · once published to npm:：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh.plus
```

Restart DSH, then open **Settings → Plugin Catalog**.
dsh.plus README · Conforms to the DSH plugin spec：This plugin follows the official DeepSeek Harness plugin model ([`deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)):
section: Conforms to the DSH plugin spec

text:
dsh.plus README · Conforms to the DSH plugin spec：- A [Cordis](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis) (`@deepseek-ai/cordis`) **dual-half plugin**:
  - **host half** (`src/`): `apply(ctx)` injects the `webServer` service and registers a read-only route;
  - **browser half** (`src/client/`, exported as `./client`): injects `slots`/`locale` and registers a page in the `settings.section` slot.
- The **`dsh.client`** manifest in `package.json` (`platform: "web"` + client dependency injection) declares the browser half.
- **`cordis.patch.yml`** (via `dsh.bundle.patch`) inserts the plugin into the profile’s layer stack so `dsh plugin add` takes effect automatically.
- The client artifact is built by **tsdown** into a lazy-CJS factory bundle that calls `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`.
section: Conforms to the DSH plugin spec

text: dsh.plus README · Conforms to the DSH plugin spec：It reuses the standard catalog-source contract dsh.plus already publishes ([`/catalog-source.json`](https://dsh.plus/catalog-source.json) + `GET /v1/plugins`, v1), so this plugin is essentially a “Path B” browser-side rendering of that directory.
section: Conforms to the DSH plugin spec

dsh.plus README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck   # both host and client projects
npm run build       # tsc (host) + tsdown (client)
npm run check       # typecheck + build + preflight guard

Artifacts: `lib/` (host, ESM) + `client/client.js` (browser factory bundle, committed). `prepack` builds and runs `preflight`, which asserts the `cordis.patch.yml` name and bundle loader id match the package name.

dsh.plus README · Project layout：```
src/
├── index.ts             # host entry: inject webServer, mount routes
├── catalog.ts           # fetch + merge + sanitize the dsh.plus catalog
├── routes.ts            # GET /dsh.plus/catalog

dsh.plus README · Relationship to dsh.plus：[dsh.plus](https://dsh.plus) is the bilingual DSH ecosystem portal and curated plugin directory. This plugin is its in-DSH rendering: the host process reads dsh.plus’s public catalog data at runtime, and this repository bundles no plugin snapshot or third-party code.

dsh.plus README · Disclaimers：- This plugin is maintained independently by the dsh.plus community and is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek AI or the official DeepSeek Harness project.
- Catalog listings are third-party open-source code; this plugin only browses metadata and does not install, execute, or review any plugin code. Verify a plugin’s source and trustworthiness before installing it.
- Compatibility: targets the DeepSeek Harness `web` client (`dsh web`) with `dsh.client` support.
